messages:
emma: Heads-up for close: we issued a set of post-bill promotional credits to five beta customers on 2026-07-28 totaling $18,450. Invoices were recognized in July. Need guidance on month-end accounting.

noah: Do we treat as contra-revenue now or wait and offset when credits apply to next invoice? Close is tomorrow.

emma: My read: contra-revenue in July so revenue reflects the economics when credit was issued. Draft JE below.

ashley: Share draft JE and support files. Also tag RevOps for approval.

emma: Draft JE (rounded):
DR 4000-Subscription Revenue    $18,450
CR 2460-Customer Credit Liability $18,450
Memo: Post-bill promotional credits applied to beta cohort, issued 2026-07-28.

revops-bot: Attached support: export_credits_20260728.csv, ticket-links (automated).

ashley: Agree with contra-revenue approach. Two notes: 1) ensure credits were authorized by Product/Marketing, 2) check if credits affect deferred revenue (if tied to future services).

tax-team: Quick note  if taxable, reduce taxable sales base; book tax adjustment JE if material.

noah: Product confirmed promos intended. I'll route JE to GL owner and RevOps for sign-off.

emma: Timing: prepare JE and evidence by 10am PT, secure approvals, post before month close at 4pm PT.

ashley: For audit trail include the marketing approval email and the promo program doc.

noah: Will attach and route now.

emma: Will update once posted. :white_check_mark:
